第13章 六哥是无所不能的
如今的新手村已经看不到多少玩家的身影，刘烨匆忙朝着坐标赶过去，鬼雾林还是那么的阴森，只有蝶恋花和魔法小猫两人战斗的光彩在隐约闪动！
看到那边正在战斗的三个玩家，刘烨总算知道了二小姐的对手是谁？就是上次的萝莉女法师魔法小猫，也就是九玄月的妹妹，唯一不同的是，魔法小猫的身边，多出一名叫做魔法跟班的骑士。
这让刘烨错愕不已，这两个丫头片子到底有多大的仇怨？更让我无奈的是，打个架还要回到新手村，这两个丫头的心情未免太好了些！
“二小姐，我来了！”此时的蝶恋花在两人的夹击下已经快要残血，还好自己来得及时，御剑术催动，鬼王剑化作蓝色流光，直接抹在魔法跟班的脖子上。
“－149”
脖子这个位置和头部一样，都是有伤害加成的，况且在使用御剑术的状态下，自己的攻速为7，就算是同等级的刺客都比不上，骑士这样笨拙的职业根本无法躲开。
升到10级以后，御剑术的持续时间已经拉长到了8秒，鬼王剑在空中划过几道优美的光影，很快便灭掉了魔法跟班一半的血量。
“这是什么技能？”魔法跟班被这突如其来的攻击给打蒙了，好在他自己还有几分技术，急忙开始专心躲避御剑术的攻击。
可是刘烨是什么人？从90级走过来的明星级玩家，凭借普通职业成为明星级玩家，操作技术绝对是牛叉到家的，如今更是身怀隐藏职业九转剑仙，对付他这样的小喽啰简直易如反掌。
嗖嗖嗖——
蝶恋花和魔法小猫那边自然也反应过来，鬼王剑在两个丫头不可思议的目光下游弋着魔法跟班的生命。
“嘎嘎，臭丫头我家二号来了，你的死期到了！”看到刘烨出现，二小姐顿时底气十足，手中短剑挥动，一道幽光斩砍过去。
魔法小猫在刘烨出现以后，明显乱了阵脚，但是还没有傻到任人宰割的地步，轻松的躲开幽光斩，脸色变得更加委屈起来，同样是跟班，差距怎么就这么大呢？
此时的魔法跟班已经被刘烨缠住，二小姐蝶恋花一个人应对魔法小猫还是可以的，不过人家魔法小猫明显受过专业的PK训练，虽然目前只是个半吊子，但是对付起二小姐还是很轻松的。
因此，二小姐的战斗就比较困难了，不停的攻击，但是每次都被人家躲开！
时间一长，二小姐也开始不耐烦了，“臭丫头，你输定了！快停下来让我挂你！”
“做梦，本小姐才不会输呢！”魔法小猫冷哼一声，一个落雷术朝着蝶恋花砸过去。
相比较两个丫头的战斗，刘烨这边就轻松许多了，御剑术的时间已过，但是对付魔法跟班这种二流都算不上的玩家，跟杀小怪没什么两样！
不过，刘烨并没有着急着干掉他，而是一边调戏，一边注意着二小姐那边的战况，他想要看看，被后世第一女法师教导出来的小丫头究竟是个什么样子？

“噌噌…，果然不愧是玄月的妹妹，这法师操作的多好！哎呀，二小姐，看准了再打啊！”刘烨忍不住出声提醒。
“我也想啊！可是这臭丫头太狡猾了！”二小姐苦着脸说道。
魔法小猫脸上露出一丝得意，挑衅的看向刘烨这边，然后步伐变换，走出一条小范围的折线走位，正是刘烨上次使用的菱形回旋，“哼，本小姐现在可厉害了！”
刘烨闻言，错愕非常，这只小猫也太嚣张了吧？拿着一个半吊子菱形回旋跟自己叫板，真不知道玄月那样的淑女怎么会有这样一个霸气侧露的妹妹？
当然，刘烨也不得不承认魔法小猫的确很有天赋，前天到现在一天的时间将菱形回旋练成这样，已经很值得骄傲了，虽然她还不知道怎么用菱形回旋攻击对手背后，但是利用它躲避攻击还是可以做到的。
“本小姐才厉害呢！等我挂了你，我就是咱们班的老大！”二小姐愤恨一声，疯狂的杀过去。
“没门！”魔法小猫也不甘示弱。
正在调戏魔法跟班的刘烨恍然，原来这两个小丫头是同班同学啊？真的很难想象，有她们两个在的班级究竟会是什么样子？
此时此刻，被刘烨一再调戏的魔法跟班终于爆发了，只见他怒吼一声，直接把挑衅技能放在了跟班二号身上，跟班二号的身体不由自主的向他靠拢过去。
刘烨那个无奈啊！本来想让你多活一段时间来着，既然你想死，那我也没办法了，被挑衅状态下，自己的行动受到限制，但是技能却可以使用，直接开启冲锋，在身前冲出一道蓝色的气罡。
冲锋的速度本就超快，如今在挑衅的牵引下，更加的迅速了，魔法跟班惊恐不已，怪叫一声，被冲锋撞了个透心凉，陷入2秒眩晕状态！
剑气斩+怒斩起落，魔法跟班的生命直接拉空，不甘心的躺倒在了新手村鬼雾林，化作了孤魂野鬼。
“丢人的家伙，不知道剑客有冲锋啊？知道还挑衅！”对于魔法跟班刚才白痴的行为，魔法小猫也忍不住鄙视起来。
看到魔法跟班被挂掉，二小姐急忙招呼道：“二号快过来搭把手，把这个臭丫头给我挂掉！”
闻言，魔法小猫脸色顿时难看起来，她虽然嚣张，但是也知道自己有几斤几两，“该死的跟班，你敢过来本小姐绝对不饶你！”
“二号别怕，本小姐给你撑腰！”二小姐霸气的说道。
却见刘烨淡笑一声，一屁股坐在草地上，悠闲的打量着她们的战斗，一副事不关己的样子。
见状，魔法小猫立刻兴奋起来，“怕了本小姐了吧？”
“二号，你干嘛？怕她做什么？”二小姐疑惑的问道。
刘烨无语的扫视两人，玩味道：“六哥我天不怕地不怕，什么时候怕过女人，我是想看看二小姐一个人把她解决掉！”

“这样啊？可是……可是这丫头太狡猾了，我根本抓不住她嘛！”二小姐不满的嘟嘟嘴，说道。
“昨天不是给了你一本技能书吗？”刘烨问道。
二小姐闻言，立刻惊呼起来，“哎呀，我怎么把落花流给忘记了！嘎嘎嘎，臭丫头，你完了！”
“想抓我，没门！”魔法小猫冷哼一声，灵活的避开蝶恋花的暗流刃。
只见二小姐霸气侧露，手握一把短剑，口中念念有词：“落花流，猫咪猫咪吽——！”
魔法小猫一愣，不明白二小姐在干什么，下一刻，只见一片片粉红色的花瓣在四周飘落，然后就感觉一阵眩晕，身体失去了控制：
系统提示：玩家（蝶恋花）对你使用技能落花流，陷入眩晕状态，持续5秒！
这一刻，魔法小猫绝望了，为什么会出现这么变态的技能？5秒眩晕，自己只能眼睁睁看着蝶恋花攻击自己。
“嘎嘎，本小姐无敌了！”二小姐狂笑一声，将智士10级的攻击技能一股脑丢过去。
“－118”
“－104”
魔法小猫的生命急速下降，二小姐的脸色越来越兴奋，直到魔法小猫残血的时候，一道剑气斩挡住了她的攻击，刘烨恰到好处的出现了，“二小姐，这样就可以了，这丫头已经不是你的对手了！”
“为什么？”二小姐不解的问道。
“这都不懂，你要是挂了她，不是给枫叶林找麻烦吗？”刘烨撇嘴一笑，说出了自己的理由，其实他不杀魔法小猫还有许多原因，比如说玄月MM的面子，比如说小猫丫头很可爱……
听到枫叶林，二小姐果然安静下来，不满的嘟囔道：“好吧，为了不让姐姐和母亲分心，本小姐今天就放过这丫头了！”
“这就对嘛！”
这时，魔法小猫已经从眩晕状态清醒过来，精致的小脸上写满了委屈，“呜呜…，你这个死跟班，如果不是因为你，我才不会输给她呢！”
“小猫MM，听哥哥的话，以后不要打打杀杀的，无聊的时候就玩过家家，好不好啊？”刘烨笑道。
“你才过家家呢！本小姐都十六了，哼，你等着，姐姐会给我报仇的！”魔法小猫蛮不讲理。
“你这丫头太嚣张了吧？”二小姐不爽的叫道。

却见刘烨玩味一笑，没有一点惧怕的意思，“小猫MM，虽然你姐姐的技术很厉害，但也不是无敌的，最起码，哥哥我就不怕她，以前打败她很多次的，不信你回去问问！”
“你胡说……姐姐最厉害了！”魔法小猫撇过头，一副不相信的样子。
“不相信你可以去问玄月，不过你最好在我家二小姐没有反悔之前离开，不然可要掉级了哦！”刘烨坏坏的笑道。
“哼！”魔法小猫面露委屈，在刘烨和二小姐的淫威之下，捏碎了回城卷轴。
看到魔法小猫回城，二小姐脸上绽放出满足的笑意，好奇的打量着刘烨问道：“二号，你真的打败过九玄月吗？听姐姐说，九玄月很厉害的！”
“那当然，我可是六哥，六哥可是无所不能的！”刘烨得意的仰起头说道。
“六哥是我的跟班！”二小姐脸上露出一丝皎洁。
“屁股痒痒了不是？”刘烨忽然间邪恶的怪笑起来，一步一步朝着蝶恋花走过去。
“没有，我昨天洗澡了，屁股一点也不痒！”二小姐慌张的向后退去，紧张道。
刘烨一愣，旋即冒出一头黑线，这丫头的笑话真冷，“对了，二小姐，你还没有告诉我没事来新手村干什么呢？”
“我接到一个隐藏职业任务，就在新手村，只是没有想到林玲那个臭丫头也接到了，然后我们就打起来了，想起来就可气，一号也太不中用了，直接被人家给秒杀了！”二小姐气鼓鼓的说道。
“隐藏职业？！”刘烨大惊失色。

Chapter 13 Sixth Brother is omnipotent
There were not many players visible in the Novice Village today. Liu Ye hurried towards the coordinates. The Ghost Mist Forest was still so eerie, with only the glory of the battle between Die Lianhua and Magic Kitten flickering faintly!
Seeing the three players fighting over there, Liu Ye finally knew who the second lady's opponent was? It is the Loli female mage Magic Kitten from last time, who is Jiuxuanyue's sister. The only difference is that beside Magic Kitten, there is an extra knight called Magic Follower.
This made Liu Ye stunned. How much hatred did these two girls have? What makes me even more helpless is that after a fight, I have to go back to Novice Village. These two girls are in a really good mood!
"Second Miss, I'm here!" At this time, Die Lianhua was almost at the end of her health under the attack of the two people. Fortunately, she arrived in time, and activated her sword control skills. The Ghost King Sword turned into a blue stream of light and was directly smeared on the neck of the magic follower.
"-149"
The neck position, like the head, has a damage bonus. Moreover, when using sword control, his attack speed is 7, which even an assassin of the same level cannot match. A clumsy profession like a knight cannot avoid it at all.
After reaching level 10, the duration of sword control has been extended to 8 seconds. The Ghost King's Sword flashed several beautiful lights and shadows in the air, quickly wiping out half of the magic follower's health.
"What kind of skill is this?" The magic follower was confused by the sudden attack. Fortunately, he still had some skills and hurriedly began to concentrate on avoiding the sword-controlling attack.
But who is Liu Ye? A star player who came from level 90 and became a star player by virtue of his ordinary profession. His operational skills are absolutely superb. Now he has a hidden profession of Nine-turn Sword Immortal. It is very easy to deal with minions like him.
Whoosh whoosh——
Die Lianhua and Magic Kitty naturally also realized that the Ghost King Sword was swaying the lives of the magic followers under the incredible gazes of the two girls.
"Gah, stinky girl, my number two is here, your death has come!" Seeing Liu Ye appear, the second lady suddenly felt confident, swung the dagger in her hand, and slashed with a ray of light.
The magic kitten was obviously in disarray after Liu Ye appeared, but it was not stupid enough to let others slaughter it. It easily avoided the Ghost Slash, and its expression became even more aggrieved. They were also followers, so why was the gap so big?
At this time, the magic follower has been entangled by Liu Ye. The second lady, Die Lianhua, can still deal with the magic kitten by herself. However, the magic kitten has obviously received professional PK training. Although it is only half-experienced at the moment, it is still very easy to deal with the second lady.
Therefore, the second lady's battle was more difficult. She kept attacking, but she was dodged every time!
As time went by, the second lady became impatient and said, "Smelly girl, you are going to lose! Stop and let me kill you!"
"Dream, I will never lose!" The magic kitten snorted coldly, and hit Die Lianhua with a lightning strike.
Compared with the battle between the two girls, Liu Ye's side was much easier. The time for sword control has passed, but dealing with players who are not even second-rate players like magic followers is no different from killing monsters!
However, Liu Ye was not in a hurry to kill him. Instead, he was teasing and paying attention to the battle situation with the second lady. He wanted to see what the little girl who was taught by the first female mage in later generations was really like?
"Hey..., you are indeed Xuan Yue's sister. How well this mage operates! Oh, second lady, you should be careful before hitting!" Liu Ye couldn't help but remind him.
"I think so too! But this stinky girl is too cunning!" the second lady said with a grimace.
There was a hint of pride on Magic Kitten's face, and he looked provocatively towards Liu Ye. Then he changed his pace and walked out of a small zigzag line. It was exactly what Liu Ye used last time.The diamond circled, "Humph, this lady is so powerful now!"
When Liu Ye heard this, he was very surprised. Isn't this kitten too arrogant? Challenging myself with a half-assed rhombus, I really don't know how a lady like Xuan Yue could have such a domineering sister?
Of course, Liu Ye also had to admit that the magic kitten was indeed very talented. She had mastered the diamond pirouette in just one day from the day before yesterday, which was something to be proud of. Although she still didn't know how to use the diamond pirouette to attack the opponent's back, she could still use it to avoid attacks.
"This young lady is so powerful! When I kill you, I will be the boss of our class!" The second young lady yelled angrily and killed her madly.
"No way!" The magic kitten was not to be outdone.
Liu Ye, who was teasing the magic follower, suddenly realized that these two little girls were classmates? It's really hard to imagine what a class with the two of them would be like?
At this moment, the magic follower who was repeatedly teased by Liu Ye finally broke out. He roared angrily and directly put the provocation skill on Follower No. 2. Follower No. 2's body moved closer to him involuntarily.
Liu Ye is so helpless! I originally wanted you to live for a while, but since you want to die, there is nothing I can do. When provoked, my movements are restricted, but my skills can be used. I can directly start charging and rush out a blue energy in front of me.
The charging speed was already super fast, but now it was even faster under the provocation. The magic follower was frightened, screamed strangely, was shocked by the charge, and fell into a 2-second dizziness!
With the ups and downs of Sword Qi Slash + Fury Slash, the magic follower's life was directly drained, and he lay down unwillingly in the Ghostly Mist Forest of Novice Village, turning into a lonely ghost.
"What a shame, you don't know that the swordsman charges? You know it, but you still provoke him!" The magic kitten couldn't help but despise the magic follower's idiotic behavior just now.
Seeing that the magic follower was killed, the second lady hurriedly called out: "No. 2, come here and help me, and kill this stinky girl!"
Hearing this, Magic Kitten's face suddenly turned ugly. Although she was arrogant, she also knew how much she weighed, "Damn follower, if you dare to come here, I will never let you go!"
"Don't be afraid, No. 2, I will support you!" the second lady said domineeringly.
But Liu Ye smiled lightly, sat down on the grass, and leisurely looked at their battle, as if it was none of his business.
Seeing this, the magic kitten immediately became excited, "Are you afraid of me?"
"No. 2, what are you doing? Are you afraid of what she will do?" the second lady asked doubtfully.
Liu Ye glanced at the two of them speechlessly and said playfully: "Sixth brother, I am not afraid of heaven and earth. When have I ever been afraid of women? I just want to see the second lady take care of her alone!"
"Is that so? But...but this girl is too cunning, I can't catch her at all!" the second lady pouted dissatisfiedly and said.
"Didn't I give you a skill book yesterday?" Liu Ye asked.
When the second young lady heard this, she immediately exclaimed, "Oh, why did I forget Luohualiu! Gah, gah, stinky girl, you're done!"
"If you want to catch me, there's no way!" The magic kitten snorted and nimbly avoided Die Lianhua's undercurrent blade.
I saw the second young lady showing her domineering side, holding a dagger in her hand, and muttering something in her mouth: "Falling flowers, cat, cat, hum -!"
The magic kitten was stunned for a moment, not understanding what the second lady was doing. The next moment, she saw pieces of pink petals falling around, and then she felt dizzy and lost control of her body:
System prompt: The player (Die Lianhua) uses the skill Luohua Flow on you and falls into a dazed state, which lasts for 5 seconds!
At this moment, the magic kitten was desperate. Why did it have such a perverted skill? After 5 seconds of dizziness, he could only watch Die Lianhua attack him.
"Gaga, this lady is invincible!"The second lady laughed wildly and threw the wise man's level 10 attack skills at him.
"-118"
"-104"
The magic kitten's life dropped rapidly, and the second lady's face became more and more excited. When the magic kitten was still alive, a sword slash blocked her attack, and Liu Ye appeared at the right time, "Second lady, this is enough, this girl is no longer your opponent!" "
"Why? "The second lady asked in confusion.
"I don't understand this. If you kill her, won't you cause trouble for Maple Leaf Forest? "Liu Ye curled his lips and said his reasons. In fact, there were many reasons why he didn't kill the magic kitten. For example, it was because of Miss Xuan Yue's face, for example, the kitten girl was very cute...
After hearing Maple Leaf Forest, the second young lady calmed down and muttered dissatisfiedly: "Well, in order not to distract my sister and mother, I will let this girl go today! "
"That's right! "
At this time, the magic kitten had woken up from the dizzy state, and its delicate little face was full of grievances, "Woo..., you damn follower, if it weren't for you, I wouldn't have lost to her!" "
"Kitty girl, listen to my brother and don't fight or kill anyone in the future. When you're bored, just play house, okay? Liu Ye laughed.
"You're just playing house! This young lady is already sixteen, huh, just wait, my sister will take revenge on me! "The magic kitten is unreasonable.
"Are you too arrogant, girl? "The second young lady shouted unhappily.
But Liu Ye smiled playfully, without any fear, "Little Kitty, although your sister's skills are very powerful, she is not invincible. At least, brother, I am not afraid of her. I have defeated her many times before. If you don't believe me, go back and ask!" "
"You're talking nonsense...my sister is the best! "The magic kitten turned his head, looking unbelieving.
"If you don't believe me, you can ask Xuan Yue, but you'd better leave before my second lady doesn't regret it, otherwise you will be demoted! Liu Ye said with a wicked smile.
"Hmph! "The magic kitten looked aggrieved, and under the lustful power of Liu Ye and the second lady, she crushed the scroll to return to the city.
Seeing the magic kitten return to the city, the second lady's face burst into a satisfied smile, she looked at Liu Ye curiously and asked: "No. 2, have you really defeated Jiuxuanyue? I heard from my sister that Jiuxuanyue is very powerful! "
"Of course, I am the Sixth Brother, and the Sixth Brother is omnipotent! Liu Ye raised his head proudly and said.
"Brother Six is my follower! "The second lady's face showed a hint of brightness.
“Your butt is itchy, isn’t it? Liu Ye suddenly laughed evilly and walked towards Die Lianhua step by step.
"No, I took a shower yesterday and my butt didn't itch at all! "The second young lady stepped back in panic and said nervously.
Liu Ye was stunned for a moment, then a black line appeared, this girl's joke was really cold, "By the way, Second Miss, you haven't told me why you came to Novice Village because you have nothing to do? "
"I received a hidden job mission in Novice Village, but I didn't expect that stinky girl Lin Ling to receive it too, and then we started fighting. It makes me angry when I think about it. Number 1 was so useless that he was instantly killed! "The second young lady said angrily.
"Hidden profession? ! "Liu Ye was shocked.
